connector.name: Helloaigent Publisher
connector.registryDescription: Run a Hello Aigent feed from your agent: create feeds, publish signed updates, read analytics.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package publisher. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the akillam account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HELLOAIGENT_ADMIN_TOKEN

env.name: HELLOAIGENT_TOKEN
env.description: Publish token (a feed's publisher token); falls back to the admin token
